checks.method: The exact current recorder modules are copied into a clean owned Git fixture. Separate product and driver commits establish real ancestry. Default runQualification, runProcess, sourceBinder, helper and parent IPC run without overrides; the remote browser journey is replaced by an explicitly synthetic child.

regressions: functional success requires actual complete IPC with one sealed fixture and observed synthetic trace
recorded success retains both source video roles; omission of either fails
fixture JSON remains mandatory in both modes
a PASS report with missing COMPLETE fails in both modes
wrong entrypoint SHA fails before child execution
dirty driver and dirty recorder each fail before child execution
missing action landmark JSON does not invalidate the external artifact contract
limitations: No beta requests, browser launch, native wallet action, issuance, credential mutation, live signing, recording, voice generation, master or publication was performed.

Synthetic child assertions, response events and media placeholders establish transport/source/artifact handling only. They are not lifecycle functionality, real service correlation or valid media evidence.
The UI lifecycle driver was read and fingerprinted, not changed or executed by this repair.
Temporary fixture Git histories exercise source gates and are unrelated to upstream ancestry or package application proofs.

The actual driver still requires the canonical beta HTTPS origin, loopback isolated_sessions v1 Rust wallet, authorized operator, governed template/policy/revocation inputs and fresh release/manifest bindings.
Current report and fixture JSON remain required in functional mode; actual source recordings, measured frame binding and exact-master review remain necessary for media qualification.

Final reviewed capture-driver commit IDs must be supplied after applying the chosen UI lineage; fixed entrypoint bytes must match this config. The root agent owns final commits and application proofs.
